text: If I feel the urge to text, then I will put my phone down and take 3 slow breaths.
If it's late at night and I'm spiraling, then I will write 3 lines about how I want tomorrow to feel.
If I see their name pop up, then I will wait 10 minutes and read my top Coping Card first.
If I'm about to open our chat, then I will open the Coping Deck and pick one grounding card.
If a memory hits hard, then I will stand up, drink a glass of water, and walk for 2 minutes.
